context: Tablet-optimized PWA for 10-year-old kids. Focus on large touch targets, scannable data, and energetic visual feedback.

typography.guidelines: Never center all text. Use left-alignment for stats/data. Headings must have high contrast and tight letter spacing.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Use p-6 inside cards as minimum to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Hero content (Live match/Top news) spans 2 columns (col-span-1 md:col-span-2).
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-3xl for major containers, rounded-2xl for inner widgets, rounded-full for buttons and pills.

components.cards: Solid white background, rounded-3xl, 2px solid border (border-slate-300). Must include the chunky bottom offset shadow to feel tactile and 'toy-like'.
components.buttons: Chunky, rounded-full, bright primary/secondary color, white text. Must have a darker offset shadow. Active state physically presses down by removing the shadow and translating Y.
components.navigation: Thick side navigation for tablet (or a prominent bottom nav). Large icons, bold labels. Active state gets a bright yellow or blue background highlight.
components.league_selector: Horizontal scrollable flex row of rounded-full pills. Selected state is solid primary color, unselected is outline/white.
components.data_display: For standings and top scorers, avoid dense excel-like grids. Use striped rows (bg-slate-50 for even rows), large avatars/logos, and big typography for numbers. Padding p-3 or p-4 per row.
components.badges: For live matches, use a vibrant green pill badge (bg-green-500) with an optional pulse animation.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Playful and bouncy. Cards scale slightly (scale-[1.02]) and increase shadow.
motion_and_interactions.active: Buttons press into the screen (translate-y-1) for physical feedback.

images.description: Football field stadium under bright lights. Perfect for the onboarding or login screen background. (Use an overlay like bg-blue-900/60 to keep text readable).
Person kicking a soccer ball. Great default image for news stories without a thumbnail, or empty states.
Gold football trophy. Use this in the Top Scorers widget/card header to make it visually exciting.

media.icons_library: lucide-react. IMPORTANT: Set strokeWidth={2.5} or {3} on all icons so they look chunky and kid-friendly, matching the typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Kid's Sports PWA Dashboard. Adopt the 'Vibrant Play' archetype. NO boring corporate SaaS styling.
Include Fredoka (headings) and Nunito (body) fonts via Google Fonts.
Construct a Bento Grid layout. Tablet view (md:) is the primary target. Make sure interactive touch targets are at least 48px tall.
Implement the 'tactile' card and button styles exactly as specified (2px borders with thick, hard shadows using Tailwind arbitrary shadow values).
Include a 'data-testid' attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, favorite toggles).
For the simple login/favorites screen, create a fun, welcoming 'clubhouse' feel, utilizing the hero_stadium image with a dark-blue overlay.
Do not use generic gray placeholders. Use the provided images, and heavily utilize the bright brand colors (sky blue, sunny yellow, vibrant green) to direct attention.
Ensure live match indicators are extremely obvious (glowing/pulsing green elements).
